items.text: Seahawks activated rookie RB Jadarian Price from IR ahead of MNF vs Bears; first action since Sept 27. Charbonnet also makes 2026 debut.
items.why: Activated from IR; source confirms plan to play tonight.
items.implication: Adds to SEA RB committee with Charbonnet return; monitor snap share for both.
items.opportunity: Potential committee work or change-of-pace role in return.

items.text: Ravens QB Tyler Huntley suffered turf toe vs Bills, expected MRI; out for foreseeable future alongside Lamar IR.
items.why: Turf toe injury; MRI pending, sources indicate extended absence.
items.implication: Ravens QB room depleted; Joe Fagnano next up for TNF and beyond.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson needs thumb surgery and will be placed on injured reserve after exiting on the first play vs Bills; could be season-ending.
items.why: Right thumb injury on first offensive play requiring surgery; coach confirms IR.
items.implication: Misses at least 4 games (earliest Week 14); Ravens turn to third-string QB; major downgrade for BAL pass-catchers short-term.

items.text: First full game without Terry McLaurin (IR, knee): Round 3 rookie Antonio Williams led WAS in routes (88%), targets (24%), and catches.
items.why: McLaurin on IR with torn patellar; Williams dominated route/target share in first full absence.
items.implication: Williams emerges as primary beneficiary in WAS WR room ROS while McLaurin out for season.
items.opportunity: High route/target share for Williams; monitor for sustained role.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) was OUT Sunday vs Raiders but is now ready to return for Week 9 vs Chiefs.
items.why: Missed fifth straight; Rap confirms ready for return next week after limited practice.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues lead role short-term; Hall likely shares on return, reducing both ceilings.
items.opportunity: Allen remains strong handcuff/start until Hall ramps.

items.text: Notable RB snaps: Broncos Jonah Coleman 41 (RJ Harvey IR), JK Dobbins 13; Raiders Mike Washington 38, Ashton Jeanty 25 (out-carried); Browns Dylan Sampson 39, Quinshon Judkins 27 (Judkins TD bet); Steelers Jaylen Warren 34, Rico Dowdle 28; Chargers Vidal 28, Mitchell 19, Omarion Hampton 18.
items.why: Post-game snap counts highlight role changes/committee dynamics and injury absences.
items.implication: Jeanty underwhelmed in carries; Judkins TD-dependent; Warren leads PIT; Hampton limited; Coleman surges with Harvey out.
items.opportunity: Warren lead back; Judkins goal-line; Coleman opportunity with Harvey IR.
items.conflict: Jeanty volume lower than expected despite pedigree.

items.text: RJ Harvey (knee) on IR/return; Broncos snaps heavily to Jonah Coleman (41) over Dobbins (13).
items.why: Knee injury leads to IR; immediate snap vacuum filled by Coleman.
items.implication: DEN RB committee shifts; Coleman primary beneficiary short-term.
items.opportunity: Coleman elevated role/snaps with Harvey out.

items.text: Pregame actives: DJ Moore, Dalton Kincaid, Aaron Jones, Jeremiyah Love. Outs: Breece Hall, Carnell Tate, Tyjae Spears.
items.why: Berry reports final pregame statuses for key fantasy players.
items.implication: Moore/Kincaid/Love clear to play; Hall/Tate/Spears sidelined impacting Jets/Titans depth.

items.text: OUT: AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson (among others). Expected to play included Jadarian Price, George Pickens, Jaylen Waddle, Colston Loveland, Kenny Gainwell.
items.why: ETR weekend injury summary board with clear OUT and EXPECTED TO PLAY designations.
items.implication: NE/NE depth impacted by Brown/Henderson absences; SEA/LAR/etc get back key pieces.
items.opportunity: Handcuffs and backups in NE; confirm snaps for returnees.

items.text: Dwain McFarland has Joe Burrow as QB2 in ROS rankings; Berry finds it hard to argue.
items.why: Strong ROS endorsement via collaborator ranking.
items.implication: Burrow solid QB1/2 ROS despite any short-term noise.

items.text: Vikings coach Kevin O'Connell: QB Kyler Murray dealing with sore hamstring, full evaluation today; seemed limited end of Sunday game.
items.implication: MIN QB uncertainty for Week 9; monitor practice reports.

items.text: Packers HC Matt LaFleur confirms Micah Parsons set to practice this week; targeting Thanksgiving Eve return vs Rams.
items.why: Coach confirms practice plan; prior sources targeted specific return date.
items.implication: GB defense boost imminent; fantasy IDP relevant, minimal offensive impact.

items.text: Jets WR routes on 35 Geno dropbacks: Garrett Wilson 34, AD Mitchell 26, Omar Cooper 26. Wilson/Mitchell/Taylor 81% target share; Cooper zero targets despite snaps.
items.why: Dominant route participation and target concentration for Wilson.
items.implication: Wilson remains clear alpha; depth WRs fight for residual but low efficiency so far.
items.opportunity: High route/target monopoly for Wilson even in loss.

items.text: Watching Jeremiyah Love (ankle) postgame among other injuries; was ACTIVE pregame per Berry but re-aggravation risk noted in reports.
items.why: Ankle issue in game; ETR flagging for monitoring; FantasyPros notes ruled out after re-aggravation in some reports.
items.implication: ARI RB depth uncertainty; monitor Week 9 practice.
